title: Herb Infused Italian Sea Bass Piadina
description: A cultured and fluffy Italian dish featuring unwaxed lemon and sashimi-cut sea bass, served in a paella pan. This macrobiotic-friendly meal is perfect for a post-workout lunch.
instructions: Preheat the paella pan over medium heat with olive oil.
Add the minced garlic and saute for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped parsley and basil and cook for another minute.
Place the sashimi-cut sea bass fillets in the pan and cook for 3 minutes per side.
Warm the piadina bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the piadina by placing a sea bass fillet on each piece of bread.
Drizzle the unwaxed lemon juice over the sea bass and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the herb infused Italian sea bass piadina immediately.
